findings: The W-question interface is not checked in the same form immediately before scored use. The worked W control and every scored W item require SHOW_IMAGE_RECORD_BARE_LABEL with response_mode bare_label, but l001-p3-W_question-model-check-understanding changes the interaction to a two-option lexical_selection CHECK_UNDERSTANDING control. Replace that check with a fresh unscored open bare-label recording interaction, or otherwise teach and check the exact production interface before l001-cp-w01-cup.

The negative interface check is underspecified and conflicts with the lesson's own ALARM rule. l001-p2-negative-model-check-understanding names bank-plate-01 and options spoon/plate but contains no displayed_mismatch_label and no action sequence that makes the wrong label visibly explicit; the contract separately mandates ALARM whenever a mismatch lacks an explicit visible wrong label and unique replacement. Freeze an exact visible mismatch operand and replacement action in this check before entering the negative gate.

The ten-page card sequence does not satisfy the normative picture-book story requirement. It serially moves the same eight labeled object cards between otherwise generic slot rows, with no visible actor, goal signal, causal consequence, or world event beyond the label display; the comprehension block asks only for the currently centered card's label and explicitly disclaims movement, order, direction, matching, staging, and interface meaning. This remains a label parade/controlled display rather than a coherent micro-event that grounds compatible world knowledge, so replace it with a prerequisite-safe event having a legible initial state or goal, meaningful development, resolution, and closed story-fact comprehension.

The story contract contains a direct eight-versus-four contradiction: picture_book.story_arc.coherence_test says every page advances a continuous four-object arrangement, while the frozen scope, all ten reviewed pages, and the other story fields contain eight objects. The same metadata calls the upper locations distinct matching positions while the pixels show eight visually interchangeable empty outlines and the resolution expressly refuses to establish matching knowledge. Correct the stale count and ensure every asserted story relation is visibly supported rather than asserted only in metadata.

TRAIN_MORE has two incompatible release algorithms. controller_transition_table says controlled_gate_fail releases reserves for failed labels, but adaptive.train_more.release_rule and each gate_execution entry list and release the whole eight-item gate reserve set whenever the base score is below 6/8, then require all released reserves correct. Specify one deterministic subset, order, denominator, score update, and terminal rule; the present controller cannot know whether to emit only failed-label reserves or all eight.

TRAIN_LONGER success cannot make the lesson FINISH-eligible. Its release predicate requires the initial mixed score to be below 26/32 and its 7/8 success transition merely says continue, while adaptive.finish still unconditionally requires mixed to reach 26/32 and defines no combined or replacement score. In addition, TRAIN_LONGER reuses eight already-scored base mixed exercise IDs rather than distinct extension event IDs. Define how the extension evidence changes the mixed terminal state, keep its score separate from the frozen 32-item denominator, and provide a reachable post-success transition to the next phase or to a declared terminal outcome.

The runtime state machine and audit contract are not complete enough for deterministic rehearsal. The transition table omits ordinary gate-pass progression, interface-check failure/replay/exhaustion transitions, story and transfer progression, closing-recap failure, TRAIN_LONGER success disposition, and explicit defer terminals; no durable per-item state/counter or required log-event schema records answer-validity basis, original versus retest score, intervention receipt, controller transition, remaining budgets, or alarm finality. maximum_teacher_turns also has no counting rule or replay preflight even though one full replay can exceed the cap after the base path and interventions. Freeze the complete state/score/log transition table and define budget accounting before rehearsal.
